# Caller proof scope experiment

Keep every original caller preparation, check and summary inside the existing
PathAsideBlock proof mechanism. Publish only the exact checked precondition
pieces outside; perform the original call. No support is removed at any check,
fuel traversal remains original, each actual check occurs once. Reject unsupported
or source-writing WF and private argument escape. Require full native controls,
strict source-keyed actual formula/full-attribute comparisons and scoped Invalid
controls. Scratch experiment only; no accepted product fix or full-suite claim.


The canonical caller variant retains all original preparation inside the proof
scope and publishes original call-procedure requirements using the existing
always_assume attribute on their nonchecking copies. Their condition objects,
formal/actual substitutions, old heaps and splitting remain the original call
contract's. No internal assertion pieces are copied into continuation assumptions.
Native controls and a direct source call with a false precondition are required.
Inherited/free calls and broader source cases still need audit before adoption.
